title: India IT eyes modest Q4 with deal pipelines strong, spending uneven - The HinduBusinessLine
summary: India'ser IT sector anticipates modest growth in Q4FY26, driven by steady demand, healthy deal pipelines, and early AI opportunities, despite elongated decision cycles and uneven discretionary spending. Large-caps show flat to low single-digit growth, supported by margins and disciplined cost management.
sentiment_reason: The market impact is neutral as the sector shows steady growth and resilience amid selective demand and ongoing digital initiatives, without major positive or negative disruptions.
